title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
job_description: Century Software Sdn Bhd, a subsidiary of Censof Holdings Berhad , is a leading provider of financial management and software solutions. Our mission is to empower businesses with innovative technology that drives growth and efficiency. We are seeking dynamic and talented individuals to join our team and contribute to our continued success. Please submit your resume to ************* Why Join Us? Work closely with passionate leaders and a supportive team culture. Exposure to innovative projects that will sharpen your professional skills. Growth opportunities in both functional expertise and leadership pathways. Location: Petaling Jaya (Work From Office) Employment Type: Full-time This role offers the opportunity to build and deploy AI solutions that are directly embedded into real business systems, including ERP, CRM, and internal platforms. You will work on meaningful use cases that impact how teams operate, deliver, and scale. About the Role As an AI Engineer, you will design, develop, and implement AI-driven solutions using machine learning and large language models (LLMs). You will work closely with cross-functional teams to identify business problems and translate them into practical, scalable systems. This role requires hands-on development, system integration, and continuous optimisation to ensure solutions are reliable, efficient, and widely adopted. Why this roles matters AI is not a side initiative within the company. It is a key driver of operational efficiency and business transformation. This role is critical in ensuring AI is not just explored, but effectively implemented and used across the organisation to deliver measurable improvements in productivity, accuracy, and turnaround time. Key Responsibilities - Develop and deploy AI-powered solutions such as automation tools, copilots, and intelligent workflows - Integrate AI capabilities into existing systems including ERP, CRM, and internal platforms - Collaborate with business and technical teams to identify high-impact AI use cases - Build and manage AI pipelines, including data preparation, model development, and optimisation - Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and production-ready using APIs and cloud platforms - Monitor performance and continuously improve solutions based on real usage and feedback Key Requirements - Strong programming skills in Python, .NET, or JavaScript - Experience with APIs, system integration, and database management - Hands-on experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, or AI frameworks - Understanding of machine learning fundamentals and AI solution architecture - Familiarity with tools such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or similar frameworks - Experience working with Microsoft technology stack (such as .NET, Azure, SQL Server, Power Platform or related enterprise technologies) and AWS cloud platforms - Ability to translate business requirements into practical technical solutions Expected the Outcome of this role - AI solutions successfully deployed into production, not limited to prototypes - Measurable improvement in efficiency, productivity, or turnaround time - High adoption rate of AI solutions across teams - Reduction in manual processes and operational errors - Continuous enhancement of AI solutions based on performance data and user feedback
